title: Base64 encoding and decoding at almost the speed of a memory copy
key_contribution: Demonstrated that AVX-512 VBMI VPERMB enables single-instruction byte compaction for Base64, approaching memcpy speed for large inputs.

title: Butterfly diagram (FFT)
key_contribution: Reference description of butterfly permutation networks as the fundamental building block of FFT data reordering.

title: Bit-permuting 16 u32s at once with AVX-512
key_contribution: Showed how to decompose arbitrary bit permutations into transposition + word permutation on AVX-512, using butterfly-like decomposition.
